daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿أَلْهاكُمُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿التَّكاثُرُ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive. ﴿زُرْتُمُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْمَقابِرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from the implied (muḍmara) an after حتى and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿كَلَّا سَوْفَ﴾ a particle of deterrence and rebuke (radʿ wa-zajr), and sawfa is for the future. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿كَلَّا﴾ a particle of deterrence and rebuke (radʿ wa-zajr). ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), muḍāf to اليقين; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿لَتَرَوُنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which has been omitted because of the succession of like letters (توالي الأمثال), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْجَحِيمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the response to the omitted oath, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَتَرَوُنَّها﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which has been omitted because of the succession of like letters (توالي الأمثال); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and hā is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ﴾ عين is an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. «a seeing of the eye» (رؤية ʿayn), and it is muḍāf to اليقين; the clause is the response to the omitted oath, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَتُسْئَلُنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which has been omitted; the wāw, omitted because of the meeting of two sukūns (iltiqāʾ الساكنين), is its fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis (nūn al-tawkīd al-thaqīla); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what precedes it. [Translator's note: the source calls the wāw the fāʿil, although the verb is passive; strictly it would be the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). Translated as written.] ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) annexed to one like it. ﴿عَنِ النَّعِيمِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.
